question: What’s the overall spatial coverage of all lakes in Freeman Township, Michigan?
sql:
SELECT SUM(ST_Area(lakes.geometry::geography)) AS area FROM lakes
WHERE water = 'lake'
AND ST_Intersects(lakes.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-84.968052 43.98796, -84.968844 43.900461, -85.088148 43.900796, -85.087834 43.987235, -84.968052 43.98796))',4326)::geography)
